drop.name: backing_in_sync
drop.why: over-claims: anyone can send tokens straight to A0 with MockToken.transfer, which changes the held balance without changing liabilities; correct behaviour would trip it. backing_bound and the 'backed' invariant cover the real property

fix.name: no_third_party_token_loss
fix.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and not called("MockToken.transferFrom") and post("MockToken.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", u)
fix.why: no token loss for others; direct MockToken.transferFrom by an approved spender is legitimate and excluded

add.name: withdraw_fee_nonnegative_effect
add.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and post("feesAccrued") < pre("feesAccrued")
add.why: withdrawals never reduce fees owed to the protocol
